units.source_text: "咱们分两组上哪儿藏藏身吧。

en.t: "Let's split into two groups and hide somewhere.

units.source_text: 两小时后再回到这亭榭来。"

en.t: Come back to this pavilion in two hours."

units.source_text: 柏木一边俯视着一直在纵情地荡秋千的情侣一边说。

en.t: Kashiwagi said this while looking down at the couple who were still swinging to their hearts' content.
